postal_system.assignment_rule: A pinned Pošta Srbije post-office list or credentialed WSP address-verification receipt establishes a five-digit destination post office at its capture time. Syntax, an office point, locality name, PAK, or public search result alone does not establish a current postcode perimeter or universal deliverability.
postal_system.pak_rule: Pošta Srbije defines the six-digit PAK as a more precise delivery-routing code for a part of a street, including side and house-number range. PAK is address-range or route evidence, not automatically a polygon, building, household, resident, or substitute for the five-digit destination post office.
postal_system.lookup_rule: The public PAK lookup returns street, house number and subnumber, populated place, five-digit destination post office and six-digit PAK, with a map display. Each query is a reference receipt; map visibility, wildcard search and returned coordinates do not grant bulk extraction or geometry redistribution rights.
postal_system.api_rule: The WSP WebAPI can return current five-digit postcode and PAK from address inputs for registered users. Credentials, contact data, shipment data and documentation examples never enter the public pack; exact endpoint version, transaction type, request purpose, response, capture time, terms, schema and digest are required.
postal_system.perimeter_rule: No nationwide official Pošta Srbije postcode or PAK polygon is assumed. A surface generated from rights-cleared RGZ house-number points joined to pinned operator postcode or PAK evidence is derived, versioned and uncertainty-bearing. Street buffers, nearest offices, administrative boundaries and Voronoi cells never become official postal geometry.
postal_system.address_rule: The RGZ Address Register is the official public address authority. Its street and house-number CSV/GPKG resources provide street identifiers, house numbers, unique address codes, municipality and populated-place identifiers, cadastral municipality, parcel references and point geometry under the Serbian Open Data License; postcode and PAK remain separately verified operator assertions.
postal_system.building_rule: Exact building display requires a source-defined RGZ address-to-building relation, a common authoritative cadastral identifier, or a reviewed explicit crosswalk to separately licensed building geometry. A house-number point, parcel reference, part-under-object number, containment, overlap, or nearest building is candidate evidence unless the authoritative relation is explicit.
postal_system.parcel_rule: Cadastral parcel and real-estate records are validation context only. A parcel is not a building, address, PAK range, postcode perimeter, delivery guarantee, or permission to publish owners, rightsholders, residents, occupants, title, value, encumbrance, restriction, phone, or shipment data.
postal_system.administrative_rule: RGZ spatial units provide autonomous-province, administrative-district, local-government, city-municipality, cadastral-municipality and populated-place context. Their polygons do not create Pošta Srbije assignment, PAK membership, deliverability, or sovereignty conclusions.
postal_system.licence_rule: Every Serbian Open Data License artifact records RGZ as source, download date, download URL and all transformations or redesigns. Portal-visible buildings, cadastre and spatial-unit layers require their own dataset-specific access, fee, licence, public-field, schema, coverage, territorial-vintage and digest review.
postal_system.crs_rule: Every geometry retains its source CRS and exact dataset metadata. WGS84 API output records the reviewed transform and version; coordinates are never relabelled without transformation.
postal_system.territorial_rule: Every release states the exact source-published territorial coverage and exclusions. Dataset coverage is not a sovereignty assertion, RS and XK records are never silently merged, and absent coverage remains explicit.

integration.coordinate_flow: coordinate -> rights-cleared RGZ house-number point or derived postal membership -> separately verified postcode and PAK -> official address hierarchy -> explicit cadastral building relation -> RS AGID cell
integration.postcode_flow: canonical five digits -> destination post-office assignment -> optional derived address-membership surface -> PAK and RGZ address candidates -> explicit building relation -> AGID cells
integration.pak_flow: canonical six-digit PAK -> operator street-side and number-range evidence -> matching RGZ address codes -> optional derived route or surface -> explicit building relation -> AGID cells
integration.building_output_gate: source-defined relationship, common authoritative identifier, or reviewed explicit crosswalk required

quality_gates.pass: Five-digit postcodes remain text and preserve leading zeroes.
Six-digit PAK retains its street-side and number-range semantics and is never stored as the five-digit postcode or assumed to be a polygon.
Every postcode and PAK assertion pins the exact Pošta Srbije source, purpose, capture time, terms, schema and digest.
Every postal surface records rights-cleared members, exclusions, method, uncertainty, validation, validity and lineage and is labelled derived.
Every RGZ address retains its unique address code, public components, point, reference date, Serbian Open Data License attribution, source URL, download date, transformations, schema, CRS and digest.
Building output has an explicit authoritative relation; a house-number point, parcel reference, containment and proximity alone never pass.
Every artifact publishes exact source coverage and exclusions without turning administrative data into a sovereignty claim.
No addressee, resident, owner, rightsholder, occupant, title/value record, contact, credential, shipment or delivery instruction is published.
Synthetic fixtures verify behavior but never satisfy production evidence gates.

stages.definition: Contracts and synthetic conformance fixtures are reviewable.
Pinned Pošta Srbije post-office, PAK and WSP receipts pass credentials, purpose, terms, freshness, schema and redistribution gates.
RGZ Address Register resources pass SODL attribution, source date, public-field, CRS, coverage, territorial and correction gates.
Derived postcode/PAK geometry and separately licensed building joins pass membership, topology, ambiguity, identifier, licence and quality gates.
